model_profile.description: Key into contracts/tokenizer-profiles.json — selects tokenizer + context_window (GOV-REU-02 never hardcoded).

context_window.description: Override for model context size. If null/absent, resolved from tokenizer-profiles.json via model_profile.

reserved_output.description: Tokens reserved for generation; input_budget = context_window - reserved_output (CTX-03).

strategy.description: CTX-04 strategy name. extension-only delegates to CTX-05 and skips mechanical truncation if compaction succeeds.

strategy_options.description: Per-strategy knobs. E.g. keep-last-n { n: number }.

warning_threshold.description: CTX-06: utilization >= threshold emits warning==='approaching'. 0.8 is default per COST-03 convention.

critical_threshold.description: CTX-06: utilization >= critical emits warning==='exceeded' even when still under budget — early trigger for RES-03.

mutate.description: CTX-RES-02: if true, truncate in place; default false (side-effect-free, new array).

compaction.description: CTX-05 extension slot — optional CompactionFn config; null means disabled.
